title: Lunar Fairy Oracle
description: A pale-skinned fairy with large white and gold butterfly wings stands amid ancient ruined columns. She wears a flowing white and purple robe, has a glowing purple halo, and holds a floating purple orb containing a white alien head while pocket watches and illustrated cards float around her.
prompt: A beautiful pale fairy with large translucent butterfly wings and cat ears stands in an ancient ruined landscape at sunset. She wears a white and purple robe with circuit-like patterns, has a glowing purple halo above her head, and holds out her hand with a floating purple orb containing a white alien head. Floating around her are melting pocket watches and illustrated cards. Black sunflowers and broken classical columns fill the foreground, dramatic orange and purple sky in the background, intricate line art details, ethereal fantasy style
